method: AI-assisted review of saved SERP titles/snippets and top-two HTML structural samples. Protected/encoded pages are not treated as complete readable audits.

pages.notes: Editorial intent: actionable error wording and field association; original interactive example.
Comparison intent: system responsibilities versus reusable visual components; decision table.
How-to: testable prototype scope; excludes tool rankings and generic prototype definitions.
Mixed SERP includes operating-system shortcuts. This page explicitly covers website keyboard testing; broad volume is not exact audience demand.
Examples intent: original empty-state copy with specific next actions, not screenshots borrowed from competitors.
Overlap with error messages retained intentionally: timing and recovery versus wording and association. Separate examples and reciprocal links.
Mixed technical/UX intent. Page covers product decisions and accessible disclosure, not an HTML implementation tutorial.
Informational mobile navigation: task priority and visible destinations; not a device-settings guide.
Practical information architecture: concrete labels and comprehension; no unsupported measured conversion uplift.
Comparison intent: orientation, task and return-state tradeoffs; no universal winner.
Practical modal decisions: interruptibility, focus return, confirmation; not a component library catalogue.
Informational loading states: when structure is known and what to show; original decision rules.
Interview planning and behavioral prompts; no invented participant findings.
How-to task writing and moderation; original test scenario, not reported client research.
Mixed commercial/editorial intent. Diagnosis page separates evidence of problems from visual preferences; links only a real portfolio case.
Accessibility testing intent: WCAG thresholds from primary source, explicit limits and exceptions.
SERP includes galleries. Page provides three original hierarchy examples and selection rules, not a claimed exhaustive inspiration collection.
Mixed templates/checkout intent: page narrows to a form review and field necessity, not downloadable design templates.
Responsive content ordering: reading order and semantic structure; not device size listings.
Motion accessibility and interaction purpose: direct state feedback and reduced motion, not animation trends.
